scripts.openapi: cd ../hub && uv run python -c "import json; from illyhub_hub.api import create_app; from illyhub_hub.config import Settings; json.dump(create_app(Settings(fake_devices=True, fake_tidal=True, _env_file=None)).openapi(), open('../app/src/lib/hub/openapi.json','w'), indent=1)" && cd ../app && openapi-typescript src/lib/hub/openapi.json -o src/lib/hub/openapi.d.ts && cd ../hub && uv run python -m illyhub_hub.messages > ../app/src/lib/hub/messages.json
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
